I can’t reliably hand-simulate this many assignments without risking an incorrect result. This Python script will execute the live assignments, ignore the stale-log comments, and print the requested answer line. Paste the assignment block into the script’s standard input:

```python
import sys

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    if not line:
        continue

    lhs, rhs = line.rstrip(";").split("<-", 1)
    lhs, rhs = lhs.strip(), rhs.strip()
    values[lhs] = int(rhs) if rhs.lstrip("-").isdigit() else values[rhs]

names = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
```
